name: OBR — EFO March 2026 welfare-spending baseline (Table 4.9)

model.name: OBR welfare spending forecast
model.method: Benefit-by-benefit expenditure forecast built on DWP/HMRC caseload and average-award models, OBR economic determinants (earnings, CPI for uprating, labour market), and announced policy ('post measures'). 2024-25 is outturn; 2025-26 to 2030-31 are the March 2026 forecast.
model.method_basis: EFO March 2026 chapter 4; OBR welfare trends reports

baseline_key: EFO March 2026 post-measures baseline (current law + announced policy as of 2026-03-03); each EFO round is a distinct baseline, not a revision
geographies: GB for DWP benefit lines, NI for Northern Ireland social security, UK for HMRC-administered lines and totals
coverage_note: This build emits Table 4.9 (post-measures welfare spending by benefit, welfare-cap and outside-cap sections). Tables 4.10 (changes since November 2025) and 4.11 (health- and disability-related welfare) are vendored in the same workbook for follow-up. The Welfare trends report (June 2026) is a separate future artifact.
diagnosis_upstream: OBR forecast models are closed; divergence diagnoses classified as external-model issues become a comparison memo, not an upstream PR.
